title: forgectl configuration
description: Schema for ~/.config/forgectl/config.yaml. The file MUST be mode 0600 or narrower (FR-007). The per-repository .forgectl.yaml uses only 'profiles'; a --var-file uses only 'values'. Both sub-forms are defined at the end of this document.

values.description: Shared value store. A value declared once here is referenced by any number of profiles through value_ref. Values live only in this file and on the platform; forgectl writes them nowhere else.

allow_delete.description: Explicit on GitHub (the 'deletion' ruleset rule). Inherent on GitLab, which always denies deleting a protected branch, so a false value is reported as satisfied rather than as drift.

push_access_level.description: GitLab only; ignored on GitHub. Maps to GitLab access levels 0, 30, 40.

profiles.description: Overrides and extends the three profiles built into the binary. A configured profile replaces its built-in namesake entirely; there is no field-level merge.

host.description: Matched against the host parsed from the remote URL.

api_url.description: Defaults to the platform's convention for this host.

token_env.description: NAME of the environment variable holding the credential. Never the credential itself.

protected_tags.description: Tag patterns apply protects. Needed because a GitLab protected variable is exposed only on protected refs, and release pipelines run on tags.

variable.description: Exactly one of value, value_ref, generator MUST be present (FR-009). No platform or instance field exists: one run targets one instance (FR-032).

value_ref.description: Key into the top-level values store. An unresolved key is a configuration error (FR-010).

generator.description: Value produced and rotated by forgectl. Skipped with a warning on a GitHub instance (FR-029).

secret.description: GitHub: true selects an Actions secret, false an Actions variable. GitLab: no effect, every variable is a CI variable.

masked.description: GitLab only. GitLab rejects a masked value that is multiline, contains a space, or is shorter than 8 characters; apply then retries once unmasked and warns (FR-043).

protected.description: GitLab only. A protected variable is exposed only on protected branches and tags.

token_name.description: Generator only. Identifies the project access token within the project.

role.description: Generator only. Maps to GitLab access levels 30 and 40.

expires_in.description: Generator only. Whole days. GitLab enforces an instance maximum, 365 days by default; exceeding it is an explicit error stating the limit (FR-052).

rotate_before.description: Generator only. Whole days, and MUST be less than expires_in.

revoke_rotated.description: Generator only. Revocation happens strictly after the CI variable write succeeds.

$comment: The two companion files below are SEPARATE documents with their own root schemas. Note that 'profiles' means different things in each: a map of definitions in config.yaml, a list of names to select in .forgectl.yaml.

repoFile.title: .forgectl.yaml (repository root)
repoFile.description: Selects which profiles apply to this repository. Consulted only when no profile is named on the command line (FR-017).

varFile.title: --var-file
varFile.description: One-off, per-repository value overrides, the highest precedence in the resolution chain of FR-044. Refused when it lies inside the working copy and git does not ignore it (FR-056), with no bypass.
